plan.title: Manually add vendor to auction participants

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow for the auction.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available auction template.
Add a product required for the auction.
Add the initial participant required to publish the event.
Publish the auction so its Participants screen is available.
Verify the auction reached its published project page.
Open the published auction's Participants screen.
Search the available vendors and manually add one not already on the round.
Assert the manually added vendor is listed and selected on the Participants screen.
Assert that manually adding the vendor increased the participant count by one.
